My OC are looking at getting EV ready. We spoke yesterday about the origin offer and responding to the working group. I also have information now on a SUPA offer,. Hi James,
Thank you for the opportunity to submit a tender for Leory Apartments energy and hot water services. We truly appreciate SUPA being considered a potential partner for this essential project.
We are confident that our proposed solution delivers exceptional value, providing immediate financial relief for both your tenants and the Owners Corporation (OC). We are pleased to offer a distinct solution where SUPA funds the total $110,000 investment required to replace all meters (residential and common area) and install three EV chargers for the building.
By partnering with us, the building receives a complete infrastructure overhaul at no upfront capital cost to the OC, while residents benefit from significantly reduced energy costs.
Proposed Pathways for the OC
Feature
Details
Common Area Energy
30% discount off VDO
Residential Energy
25% discount off VDO
Hot Water
20% discount off Market Rates
Annual Credit
$8,000 yearly common area credit
EV Infrastructure
Fully funded 3-phase EV chargers
Key Benefits for Leory Apartments:
Zero Capital Outlay: SUPA covers the full $110,000 for new equipment and professional installation.
Immediate Budget Relief: Our structure provides immediate improvements to the OC’s bottom line, including an $8,000 annual common area credit.
Welcome credit: $100 credit towards the resident's energy bill 
Resident Savings: With a 25% discount to the VDO, residents will see a tangible decrease in their cost of living.
Modernised Efficiency: New smart meters and EV chargers for the common area will significantly improve the building’s operational efficiency and asset value for the next decade.
We would welcome the opportunity to present these options to the committee to answer any specific questions they may have.
Please let us know when you have had a chance to review this information, and we can coordinate a time to discuss the next steps.. Please evaluate
